 species listed above are designated *Prohibited* under NYS DEC invasive species regulations.

**Publication Date:** September 10, 2014 (effective 6 months thereafter).  
**Reference URL:** https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf

**Terrestrial Plants (Prohibited)**

- Chinese Lespedeza – *Lespedeza cuneata*

- Gray Florist’s Willow – *Salix atrocinerea*  
- Japanese Angelica Tree – *Aralia elata*  
- Japanese Barberry – *Berberis thunbergii*

- Japanese Honeysuckle – *Lonicera japonica*  
- Japanese Hops – *Humulus japonicus*

**Wetland Plants (Prohibited)**
